Remove both together (pnpm remove + delete mock), run full suite.

title: Footer: add Feedback link
description: Figma sub-footer: Terms of use | Right to know | Privacy policy | Accessibility | Feedback (white underlined links on black). Current: PinboardShell.vue:51-55 uses @phila/phila-ui-app-footer@1.2.3 sub-footer-only, which ships the first four but no Feedback link. Investigate whether AppFooter accepts extra links (props/slots); if not configurable, decide with Darren (append via slot/wrapper vs upstream request). Feedback target URL TBD — ask Darren (likely a phila.gov feedback form).
acceptance_criteria: Feedback link present in sub-footer alongside existing links, or documented decision why not; tests pass.

title: Align AnswerDetailPage 'Start a report' CTA label with new 'Submit request' wording
description: Spec review of pb-gil noted apps/philly-311/frontend/src/pages/AnswerDetailPage.vue:72 still says 'Start a report' while the landing callout now says 'Submit request' per Figma. Decide whether app-wide label consistency is wanted (check the Answers detail Figma frame if one exists) and align if so.

title: Verify header defaults: language links + search icon
description: Figma trusted bar: flag + 'An official website...' + "Here's how you know" dropdown; right side English / Español / 中文 links + globe dropdown. Global menu has a search icon. AppHeader (@phila/phila-ui-app-header) ships TrustedSite, LanguageSwitcher, NavbarSearch as defaults — verify (run app, screenshot) they render per design with our config (:show-trusted-site=true, :links=[]). Only file follow-up issues if something is missing/off; do not build.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot evidence header matches design for trusted bar, languages, search icon; discrepancies filed as new bd issues.

title: Map controls: move BasemapToggle into bottom-right stack
description: Figma: single vertical control group bottom-right (locate, zoom+, zoom-, layers). Current LandingPage.vue:62-95: MapNavigationControl bottom-right + GeolocationButton bottom-right (desktop), BasemapToggle top-right. Change BasemapToggle position to bottom-right so all controls stack per design; verify stacking order locate -> + -> - -> layers; keep mobile teleport behavior (PinboardBody mobile controls) working. Accept map-core's own button styling.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop: one bottom-right stack ordered locate, +, -, basemap; mobile unchanged; tests pass.

title: Cluster badge styling vs design
description: Figma clusters are pale grey/white oval badges with count ('611', '3'); current ClusterBadge.vue is a blue circle with white border, three size tiers (sm<10, md<100, lg>=100). Cosmetic alignment: compare with design and restyle if worth it. Low priority — confirm with Darren before large changes.
acceptance_criteria: Decision recorded (restyle or keep); if restyled, matches design and tests pass.

title: MapIconTextPin color variant vs design
description: Design Code Connect for pins: MapIconTextPin color='Dark Primary Blue' (node 10631:62821 etc). Current: packages/ui ClusteredMarkers.vue:47-57 passes color-theme='light-primary'. Verify against Figma screenshot (pins render white with colored icon circle) which variant matches, then set the right prop. Likely one-prop change; confirm visually with Playwright against the design screenshot in scratchpad (landing-design.png).
acceptance_criteria: Pin variant matches design visually; screenshot comparison done; tests pass.

title: Filter panel fullscreen: no Escape-to-close or focus trap (package gap)
description: @phila/phila-ui-filter-panel@1.0.0 fullScreen mode handles neither keydown.escape nor focus trapping (verified in dist during pb-jbh quality review). philly-311 FilterChips.vue is the app's first fullscreen use. Options: consumer-level @keydown.escape wrapper in FilterChips.vue, and/or upstream issue against phila-ui. Focus trap really belongs upstream.
acceptance_criteria: Escape closes the panel in-app; upstream issue filed for focus trap (or both fixed upstream).

title: Move search above filter chips in landing panel
description: Figma order: title/intro -> CTA -> search -> chips -> count -> cards. Current: chips render above search because chips live in the #locations-header slot (apps/philly-311/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.vue:37-44 passes ReportCallout + FilterChips) while the search input renders inside LocationsPanel via packages/ui/src/components/LocationSearchFilterPanel.vue:121-126 (phila Search, placeholder 'Search by address or ZIP' — placeholder/behavior stays as-is per Darren). Rework slot layout so search sits between CTA and chips. Likely touch: LandingPage.vue slot usage, packages/ui PinboardBody.vue / LocationsPanel.vue / LocationSearchFilterPanel.vue.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop panel order matches Figma: callout, search, chips, count, cards. Mobile bottom-sheet flow unbroken. Tests pass.

title: Landing panel copy: title, intro, About link, CTA label
description: Figma node 9789:29821 (311-Mobile-App, aRmWuYVwmG9S2gXdJxCjqL). File: apps/philly-311/frontend/src/components/ReportCallout.vue. Changes: (1) title h2 'Report Issues Around You' -> 'Submit a report to 311'; (2) intro copy -> "Let us know if there's a non-emergency issue that needs attention. The Philly311 team will direct your report to the right department." followed by inline bold underlined link 'About Philly311.' -> https://www.phila.gov/departments/philly311/ (opens new tab); (3) CTA RouterLink label 'Start a report' -> 'Submit request'. Keep existing structure: filled pill + report-document.svg illustration (deliberate keep-as-is from phila-ui migration).
acceptance_criteria: Panel shows new title, intro, working About Philly311 link, CTA reads 'Submit request'; existing ReportCallout tests updated; all tests pass.

title: Shared sub-footer default-links component for packages/ui
description: After pb-22e, the four AppFooter default sub-footer links (terms-of-use, open-records-policy, privacypolicy, accessibility-policy) are duplicated near-verbatim in apps/philly-311/frontend/src/App.vue (~36-41) and apps/oem-flood-finder/frontend/src/App.vue (~157-163), each with the same .sub-footer-link CSS, because @phila/phila-ui-app-footer@1.2.3's subFooterSlot replaces defaults wholesale (no append API). Cut: small SubFooterLinks.vue in packages/ui rendering the four defaults; each app appends its own Feedback anchor (philly-311: phila.gov/feedback/; oem: formstack URL with target=_blank). Touch both apps in one change.
acceptance_criteria: Both apps consume the shared component; rendered links unchanged; tests green.

title: Desktop report count line above card list
description: Figma: grey 16px text 'N reports' between chips and card list (e.g. '192 reports'). Current: count only exists in mobile bottom-sheet header via locationCountLabel in packages/ui/src/components/PinboardBody.vue:153-157,427-428 ('No locations match' / 'N items'). Add the count line to the desktop panel above the list and use 'report'/'reports' wording in philly-311 (label likely needs to be slot- or prop-driven since packages/ui is shared with oem-flood-finder).
acceptance_criteria: Desktop panel shows 'N reports' matching filtered count; updates when filters/search change; oem-flood-finder unaffected; tests pass.

title: All Filters opens real filter panel (@phila/phila-ui-filter-panel)
description: Decision (Darren 2026-07-21): pull in the real filter panel. Add @phila/phila-ui-filter-panel@1.0.0. Current: apps/philly-311/frontend/src/components/FilterChips.vue wraps @phila/phila-ui-filter-chip FilterChipGroup with :filter-button=true, filter-button-text='All Filters', and resetToAll() on click (FilterChips.vue:47-49,58-59). Change: All Filters button opens the filter panel instead of resetting. Panel filters by service type (single-select filter model in useReportFinder.ts — chips fake single-select over toggle chips at FilterChips.vue:40-45). Keep chips behavior otherwise. Design shows sliders icon on the All Filters chip.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking All Filters opens phila filter panel; selecting a service type in the panel filters list+map same as chips; panel and chips stay in sync; tests cover open/select/clear; all tests pass.

title: ReportListingCard: match Figma card layout
description: Decision (Darren): match Figma exactly. File: apps/philly-311/frontend/src/components/ReportListingCard.vue. Figma card (node 10618:63345): 72px square thumbnail, 8px radius, left; content column: title row = serviceType label (Montserrat SemiBold 16) with a 24px circular status icon at the row's right — resolved: circle-check on success-container bg (#caecc8, icon #07570f); in-progress: clock on #e5cefa bg (icon #030831); below: address (14px); bottom row: timestamp 12px grey formatted 'MM/DD/YY • h:mm A' (e.g. '10/10/26 • 1:57 PM'); card separator = 1px bottom border #ccc; no card-level rounding/shadow. Remove vs current: status Tags pill overlaid on image (:29-34), colored service-type glyph before title (:37-44), colored dot + distance aside (:48-51). Check formatCardTimestamp output vs 'MM/DD/YY • h:mm A'. Map current statuses to the two icon treatments (check statusTagColor for the existing status set; closed/resolved -> check, everything open/in-progress -> clock).
acceptance_criteria: Card renders thumbnail, title + status icon, address, timestamp per Figma; no distance, no pill, no leading glyph; status icon has accessible label; component tests updated and pass.

title: Map: location-estimate accuracy circle at user position
description: Figma: translucent blue circle (~174px at city zoom) centered on the user's geolocated position (node 9789:29946 'Location Estimate'). Current: no accuracy circle anywhere in app; geolocation only seeds map center (apps/philly-311/frontend/src/composables/useReportFinder.ts:67-72); GeolocationButton from @phila/phila-ui-map-core in LandingPage.vue #map-content. Check first whether map-core's GeolocationButton/maplibre GeolocateControl already supports showAccuracyCircle; else add a maplibre circle layer sized from position.coords.accuracy (meters -> pixels by zoom). Fill: primary blue ~20% opacity, subtle stroke.
acceptance_criteria: After granting location, a translucent blue circle renders at user position scaled to reported accuracy, updates on re-locate, hidden when permission denied; tests cover the composable/layer logic; all tests pass.

title: Filter chips: single-row overflow with chevron pager
description: Figma: chips render in one non-wrapping row inside the 448px panel; overflow is handled by a floating 32px round white icon button (chevron, drop-shadow 0 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15)) overlaid at the row's right edge to scroll/page to more chips. Current FilterChips.vue relies on FilterChipGroup default layout (wraps). Implement single-row horizontal scroll with the chevron affordance (hide when no overflow). Check FilterChipGroup API first for built-in overflow support before hand-rolling.
acceptance_criteria: Chips never wrap; chevron appears only when chips overflow; clicking scrolls to reveal hidden chips; keyboard/scroll accessibility preserved; tests pass.

title: Header nav: Map/Reports/Answers links, Report an issue button, Login/Sign up
description: Figma header (union-blue global menu): nav links Map, Reports, Answers; filled 'Report an issue' button; 'Login / Sign up' item; search icon. Current: PinboardShell.vue:24-45 passes :links="[]" to @phila/phila-ui-app-header AppHeader; only app-added item is Answers RouterLink via #navbar-end in apps/philly-311/frontend/src/App.vue:18-20. Changes: (1) Map -> '/' ; (2) Reports -> new stub route/page (decision: Reports page exists conceptually, not built — stub for now: route /reports + minimal page with heading, registered in router/index.ts); (3) keep Answers; (4) 'Report an issue' filled PhilaButton -> /report; (5) 'Login / Sign up' wired to @phila/sso-vue login (auth plumbing exists, see authGuard router/index.ts:37-59). Prefer AppHeader's links API over hand-rolled markup; PinboardShell may need a prop/slot passthrough since it's shared.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows Map, Reports, Answers, Report an issue button, Login / Sign up; Reports routes to stub page; Report an issue routes to /report; login triggers SSO flow; oem-flood-finder header unaffected; tests pass.
